name: Temporal Consistency Analysis
description: Detects frame-to-frame inconsistencies in video that indicate AI generation or manipulation.
useCase: Detecting AI-generated or manipulated videos through temporal coherence analysis
mechanism: Analyzes consecutive video frames for temporal consistency in color, lighting, texture, and object boundaries. AI-generated videos often exhibit flickering, warping, or sudden changes between frames that natural video does not have.
accuracy: High - 82-92% on most deepfake and AI-generated videos
source: Gu et al. (2022) - Exploiting Fine-Grained Face Forgery Clues via Progressive Enhancement Learning, AAAI
algorithm: Frame Differencing + Optical Flow Consistency + Temporal Gradient Analysis
parameters: Frame sample rate: adaptive, Window size: 5-15 frames, Metrics: MSE, SSIM, temporal gradient variance
strengths:
• Very effective for detecting deepfake videos
• Can identify subtle temporal artifacts invisible to human eye
• Works across different video resolutions
• Complements spatial analysis methods
limitations:
• Requires video input (not applicable to images)
• Computationally intensive for long videos
• May produce false positives on heavily compressed videos
• Scene cuts can interfere with analysis

references.title: Gu, Z. et al. (2022). Exploiting Fine-Grained Face Forgery Clues via Progressive Enhancement Learning. AAAI.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
